name: svelte
description: web development for the rest of us
one_liner: A tool programmers use to build fast, lightweight websites and web apps.
buyer: No direct buyer — this is free, foundational web-development infrastructure, not something a non-technical business pays for directly.
business_use_cases: An agency builds client websites/apps with it because it ships faster, smaller sites than alternatives.
A startup picks it as their frontend framework to reduce bundle size and improve load-time conversion.
No standalone commercial product opportunity beyond using it as a building block for other products.

money_ideas.idea: Offer Svelte development/consulting services to agencies and startups who want to adopt it.

steal_this: Nothing to productize directly — the opportunity is offering Svelte dev services, not building on the framework itself as a product.
